about_the_game:
This is an RPG where NPCs, items, locations, stories, and every aspect of the world are generated in real time by both AI and the player. You may seek wealth and fame through grand adventures, or simply live out your days working quietly in town — how you live is entirely up to your own words.

Natural Language Actions

The game progresses through a back-and-forth exchange of natural language between the player and the AI. You can act freely — making use of skills, items, and the surrounding environment on the spur of the moment to gain an advantage in combat or exploration.

Highly Flexible Character Creation

Appearance, background, skills, Items and more are described in natural language, allowing you to create an original character with high degree of freedom and variation.

Free Conversation and Relationship Building with NPCs

There are no fixed lines of dialogue. You can freely talk with NPCs of all kinds, each with their own personality, and build relationships through genuine interaction.

Permanent Death and Inheritance

If a character’s HP reaches zero, they die and cannot be revived. Upon the death of a player character, some of the wealth and assets they accumulated in life can be carried over to future playthroughs.

Lifespan and Resource Management

Even if you never fall in battle, your character will eventually grow old and reach the end of their life. Age, injuries, fatigue, and living expenses all influence your limited time, making the way you spend it a crucial part of the game.

・・・

Although it features a UI reminiscent of traditional RPGs, the game contains many elements of a life simulation. In the beginning, you are born as an extremely weak individual and face a harsh life. Some days may be spent earning meager wages through tedious labor rather than adventuring. If you manage to achieve success in your adventures, you can recruit allies to take on even greater challenges, or spend your hard-earned wealth to live a peaceful life until your final days.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game does not contain sexual acts or depictions in either text or visuals. While marriage and romantic relationships with NPCs are possible, no explicit sexual content is shown or implied.

There is no non-consensual sexual content or BDSM themes. Some characters may use magic to charm or dominate others, resulting in temporary control or servitude, but this is presented as part of a fantasy combat system and not depicted in a sexualized or fetishized manner.

Combat includes the possibility of characters being confused, controlled, or forced to perform self-damaging actions. These are presented as gameplay mechanics and not as depictions of self-harm. 

Alcoholic beverages and drug-like healing items exist as in-game items, but are not the focus of the gameplay or narrative.

name: Instantale

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 (when no dGPU is installed) or any AVX2-compatible CPU (when a dGPU is installed)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: None required with a high-performance CPU, or a Vulkan-compatible discrete GPU with 4 GB VRAM (required when using a lower-performance CPU)
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: -
  • VR Support: -
  • Additional Notes: Runs on typical PCs when using cloud AI, while local execution requires either a GPU with 8GB+ VRAM or a high-performance CPU with large DDR5 memory (32–64GB recommended) capable of hosting Stable Diffusion 1.5 and an LLM simultaneously.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-13600 with dual-channel DDR5 memory (when no dGPU is installed), or any AVX2-compatible CPU (when a dGPU is installed)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: CUDA-compatible discrete GPU with 16 GB VRAM, Turing generation or newer
  • Sound Card: -
  • VR Support: -

short_description: This is an RPG where the world, dungeons, NPCs, items, and even the story are all generated on the fly by AI. Players can freely converse with truly unique NPCs, explore the world in search of endlessly diverse items, or simply choose to live an ordinary life without doing anything at all.
